features.quote: The loop ends on: wall-clock exceeded, `max_turns`, 3 consecutive idle (no-tool) turns
features.justification_quote: captures terminal collapse (the agent stops acting) cheaply without waiting out the full turn budget
30 turns captures onset *and* collapse without runaway cost. This is the main cost-per-run lever

features.quote: Per-turn tool-call and wall-clock caps bound pathological runs
features.justification_quote: so one bad run can't blow the budget

features.quote: There's a `stop_on_giveup` flag for people who want the opposite; it defaults off
features.justification_quote: Ending the run on submit would cut off exactly the collapse we're trying to capture
